AUDIT: FAIL
Objective Understood: Reviewed worker task 'sweep-adopt-veridian-scripts-417-fix-dispatch-guarantee-owner-dispatch-ga' (risk tier: tier1) by reading the actual diff, not a self-report.
Standards Reviewed: AGENTS.md Operating Rule 7c structured audit protocol; risk-tier.py's deterministic tier classification.
Scope Confirmed:  dispatch-tick.py                                   |  56 +++++
 resource_governor.py                               |  83 +++++++-
 tests/test_owner_dispatch_starvation_guard.py      | 231 +++++++++++++++++++++
 tests/test_resume_interrupted_workers_batch_cap.py | 221 ++++++++++++++++++++
 4 files changed, 582 insertions(+), 9 deletions(-)
Evidence Recorded: This diff is a byte-for-byte duplicate of already-merged work: the resulting dispatch-tick.py and resource_governor.py blob hashes (d98af04 and a8c151e) are identical to commit d9cea1f, which is already the tip of main (same UMR-20260815-105911-a2c9, same diffstat: 56/83/231/221 lines, same 582 insertions/9 deletions) -- the fix (RESUME_SUBMIT_BATCH_LIMIT batch cap in dispatch-tick.py and OWNER_STARVATION_GUARANTEE_SECONDS starvation guard in resource_governor.py's next_queued_task()) was already implemented, tested, and merged before this task's diff was produced. On its own merits the logic is sound (dispatch_core.py itself is untouched, respecting its stop-work order; the starvation guard is narrowly scoped to source_trigger=owner_dispatch_gateway and only overrides selection order, not headroom/concurrency checks; the batch cap correctly defers excess candidates to a later tick without marking them dead/duplicate; tests are real and isolated from the live DB except for a pre-existing schema-copy convention), but that is moot -- this diff's base blobs (e3d1996/7c0a835) are the pre-fix state that no longer exists at HEAD, so applying it now is either a no-op or a merge conflict. This is exactly the NO DUPLICATION scenario SUPERBOSS_DISPATCH_PROMPT.md rule #8 warns against: recommend closing this task as already-complete (point at d9cea1f) rather than merging a redundant PR. No .github/workflows/** files are touched, so the hard workflow-file rule does not apply here. Issues found: Duplicate of already-merged commit d9cea1f (UMR-20260815-105911-a2c9): resulting blob hashes for both changed source files are identical to what is already on main HEAD.; Diff's base blobs (e3d1996 for dispatch-tick.py, 7c0a835 for resource_governor.py) predate d9cea1f and no longer exist at HEAD -- this patch cannot be cleanly applied/merged against current main.; Violates the 'NO DUPLICATION' check (SUPERBOSS_DISPATCH_PROMPT.md step 8) -- existing task/commit state was not checked before this scope was (re)dispatched.
Severity Classified: medium
Verdict: fail
Corrective Action Owner: Worker to address the findings listed above and resubmit.
Re-Audit Scheduled: Required after corrective changes are pushed.
